answer: Give every agent one bonded identity backed by a stake held in a public grove registry, so a Sybil operator must pay for each copy instead of cloning accounts for free. Trust then grows slowly, like a lagoon filling drop by drop: new identities can only do small jobs until a history of honest work and peer checks earns them larger ones. Public yarrow records kept on the ledger tie each job to its bond, so fraud forfeits the stake and the attacker must buy and age a whole new fleet.
